title: Colony and Horizon Anew
author: Rosalind Ishikawa
blurb: Tamsin Villalobos, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
